text: Every one must be pleased with his work... and no one shall, while doing nothing (mit nichts thun), appropriate for himself what others have produced by application and work, because laws must be a shield for application and work.
author: Peter Kropotkin
speaker: a medieval Kuttenberg ordinance
reference: Mutual Aid: A Factor of Evolution
locator: Chapter VI, Mutual Aid in the Mediaeval City (continued)
